item.title: Fort St. John protest planned over status in Canada of man found guilty of killing girlfriend in Mexico
item.description: A protest is to be held in Fort St. John on February 8th at 12 p.m. to object to Ryan Friesen's 'freedom,' after he has newly been found guilty of killing his girlfriend Kiara Agnew in Mexico.

item.title: Fort St. John RCMP arrests three wanted people
item.description: In a series of press releases, the Fort St. John RCMP announced the arrests of wanted Charlynn Mae Woloschuk, Shayne Steve Karey and Chad Cameron Travis.

item.title: (UPDATE) Huskies’ final home game versus Vipers cancelled
item.description: The Fort St. John Huskies' last home game of the 2025-26 season against the Sexsmith Vipers was cancelled on January 30th due to freezing rain and travel conditions.

item.title: Heavy rain in B.C.’s Comox Valley prompts state of emergency, evacuations
item.description: COURTENAY — A state of emergency on Vancouver Island has residents in the Comox Valley on high alert this morning as heavy rain prompts evacuations. The Comox Valley Regional District has issued an evacuation order for a campground and 12 properties. The evacuation order comes after the B.C. River Forecast Centre issued a flood warning […]

item.title: City proposes 100 projects worth $54.62 million for 2026
item.description: The City of Fort St. John has revealed its draft capital budget for 2026, which outlines almost 100 projects slated to cost $54.62 million this year. None of that funding would come from taxes.

item.title: Owner of B.C. ghost town taking another swing at energy exports
item.description: CALGARY — Krishnan Suthanthiran is trying to make Kitsault, B.C., happen — again. The Indian-born, U.S.-based medical technology entrepreneur says he spent about US$7 million two decades ago to purchase the uninhabited one-time mining town at the end of a scenic fiord. item.title: Energeticcity.ca Weekly Review: Winter Fest begins for 2026
item.description: In this edition of the Weekly Review, we spoke to Councillor Trevor Bolin to learn more Fort St. John's reimagined Winter Fest, which starts today. Plus, the most-read stories of the week.

item.title: Three people charged with first degree murder after death in Dawson Creek
item.description: Three people have been charged with first degree murder after Robert Eric Douglas Girbav was found dead in Dawson Creek in 2023.

item.description: DAWSON CREEK — Police in Dawson Creek, B.C., say three people have been charged with first-degree murder more than two years after a 37-year-old man was found dead in a vehicle on New Year’s Eve in 2023.
